channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Iran may be working on biological weapons, Trump says
item.description: President Trump told Fox News there are indications Iran may be working on biological or chemical weapons as the war drags on toward its ninth month.

item.title: Trump-Putin-Xi meeting updates: Schumer calls trip a 'historical embarrassment'
item.description: Trump participated on Thursday in the first-ever trilateral meeting with Putin and Xi.

item.title: Mayor Mamdani announces plan to shut down Rikers Island
item.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani unveiled his strategy to shut down Rikers Island and replace it with four smaller jails across the city.

item.title: Army postpones plan to detonate nearly 10,000 pounds of lead azide until Monday
item.description: Two rapid controlled detonations scheduled to take place at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown on Friday have been postponed by three days.
